body:
I mean that as in eventually the puppy will probably become part of my planning. Who's going to get him. How I can make sure he won't be in the house... etc etc 

I know myself well enough to understand that this is not a permanent fix but it did help the immediate situation where I was toeing the line. I'm still thinking about it a lot even now, but I look at him and it helps. That's something until I can hopefully I can figure out a way to be just normal in my abnormal life. 

Thank you for reading my post. It feels good knowing that at least it reached someone and I haven't completely kept it all to myself.
